dependent_reads.acceptance: Store every raw MCP payload before Python parsing; require offset continuity, actual final eof, total161423, per-chunk SHA, and full exact871e78… SHA. Preserve original JSON bytes without JS integer round-trip.

adaptive_next_step_after_receipt_read: Extract the actual builder_elf identity, recorded Cargo build argv/environment, and build stdout/stderr exact path/size/SHA from the verified original receipt.
If exact recorded output supplies a surviving artifact path, form one bounded exact query from that evidence; do not invent a deps hash or search other users/Android/process memory.
A bounded listing of a directory would require that directory to be established by the actual receipt/Cargo output first and its separate reviewed read scope.
important_limitations: The strict inherited held_file identity includes device/inode/mode/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns. A new copy of matching bytes cannot satisfy the old identity.
Even a surviving Cargo hardlink would need current stat/hash evidence; adding/removing a hardlink changes ctime, so same inode alone does not establish the original full identity.
No repair can be marked ready until actual preservation/recovery evidence and a legitimate current qualification path are reviewed. No timestamp fabrication or silent guard weakening is proposed.
